nodes.title: Robertson's conjecture for real-coefficient and close-to-convex functions

nodes.summary: A function $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ has real Taylor coefficients at $0$ when, for every natural number $n$, the value $f^{(n)}(0)$ of its $n$-th iterated derivative at $0$ is real (equivalently, every Taylor coefficient $f^{(n)}(0)/n!$ is real).
nodes.title: Real Taylor coefficients at the origin

nodes.summary: A function $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ is close-to-convex when it belongs to the class $S$ (analytic at every point of the open unit disc $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$, injective on $\mathbb{D}$, $f(0) = 0$ and $f'(0) = 1$) and there are a starlike function $g$ and a real number $\alpha$ such that $\operatorname{Re}\bigl(e^{i\alpha} z f'(z) / g(z)\bigr) > 0$ for every $z \in \mathbb{D}$ with…
nodes.title: Close-to-convex functions

nodes.summary: Given $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$, a function $h : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ is a normalized odd square root $h(z) = f(z^2)^{1/2}$ when, on the open unit disc $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$, $h$ is analytic at every point and satisfies $h(z)^2 = f(z^2)$ and $h(-z) = -h(z)$ for all $z \in \mathbb{D}$, and moreover $h(0) = 0$ and $h'(0) = 1$.
nodes.title: Normalized odd square roots

nodes.summary: A function $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ belongs to the class $S$ when it is analytic at every point of the open unit disc $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$, injective on $\mathbb{D}$, and satisfies $f(0) = 0$ and $f'(0) = 1$.
nodes.title: Normalized univalent functions (class $S$)

nodes.summary: A function $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ is starlike when it belongs to the class $S$ (analytic at every point of the open unit disc $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$, injective on $\mathbb{D}$, $f(0) = 0$ and $f'(0) = 1$) and $\operatorname{Re}\bigl(z f'(z) / f(z)\bigr) > 0$ for every $z \in \mathbb{D}$ with $z \ne 0$.
nodes.title: Starlike univalent functions

nodes.summary: For a function $h : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and a natural number $n$, $c_n(h) = h^{(n)}(0) / n!$, where $h^{(n)}$ is the $n$-th iterated derivative of $h$. For $h$ analytic near $0$ this is the $n$-th Taylor coefficient of $h$ at $0$; Robertson's problem uses it at odd $n$.
nodes.title: Taylor coefficients at the origin

nodes.summary: For a function $h : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ with Taylor coefficients $c_k = h^{(k)}(0)/k!$ at $0$ and a natural number $n$, the Robertson bound for $h$ at $n$ is the inequality $|c_1|^2 + |c_3|^2 + \dots + |c_{2n-1}|^2 \le n$ (for $n = 0$ the sum is empty).
nodes.title: Robertson's bound
